headline: Bitcoin Holds Near 83k as Spot Funds Lose $487 Million and Greed Runs Ahead of the Cash
narrative: Spot bitcoin funds shed $487 million in the latest print, ether funds lost about $161 million, and solana funds lost $4.8 million, while bitcoin holds near 83k after a 0.9% decline. The cycle index sits at 57, flat, in complacency, and fear and greed is already at 69, so sentiment is leaning in while the cash is still leaving the funds. Funding is calm at 0.004%, the dollar is firm at 102.59, and the VIX is quiet at 15, with seven-day realized volatility at 21.6% against 49% over thirty days, so the outflow is not being chased by leverage or a volatility bid.
author: jordan
